description: Data from the publication: Linking reported drought impacts with drought indices, water scarcity and aridity: the case of Kenya is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by 4TU.ResearchData. This dataset have been used to assess the relation between reported drought impacts, drought indices, water scarcity, and aridity across several counties in Kenya. We have collected monthly county-specific drought impact data from county-specific bulletins (County Early Warning Bulletins) of the National Drought Management Authority (NDMA) in Kenya. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher 4TU.ResearchData. Its tags are Soil Sciences, FOS: Agriculture, forestry and fisheries, Environmental Science and Management, FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences, Land and Water Management. The repository dates the deposit 2022; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
